verdict.rationale: Keycloak exposes an Admin REST API and OIDC endpoints, so asking about API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioned API paths, a compatibility guarantee, or a deprecation policy. Product release numbers (e.g. 26.7.x) and the existence of Admin REST API documentation are not API versioning, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404.
